quest.title: Our Chenyu Vale Trek
quest.description: Hezhe Post seems to be organizing an interesting event named "Our Chenyu Vale Trek"...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Are you here to take part in the "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" scenic photography contest?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Scenic photography contest? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: It's exactly as its name implies. It's a contest designed to promote the beautiful scenery of Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: We previously surveyed the vale's residents to collect opinions regarding its most captivating scenic spots. Now, we're tasking contestants with going to and capturing images of said locations using their Kameras.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Lastly, we'll pick out a handful of exceptional ones to use as promotional examples, which will be exhibited on the street outside Hezhe Post. Well? How about it, you two?

choices.text: I'm a practical person. What prizes are up for grabs?

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Of course there is. If your works are chosen, there'll be a special surprise just for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! A surprise!? We'd better give it our all, then!

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Heh, we've still prepared a little reward for your time and effort even if your work isn't selected. We hope it'll be to your satisfaction.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where do I start?

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Have a look at this guide. These are the residents' recommended scenic spots of Chenyu Vale.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why are some of the locations crossed out?

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Heh, that's because those locations have been fully signed up for. We're hoping to provide a more comprehensive display of Chenyu Vale's beauty.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: These four remaining locations are still available for registration. You can select one or more of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon gets it now... {NICKNAME}, how about we sign up for all of the remaining locations?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If our chance of winning the prize is one in four, then we'd be guaranteed to win if we take four photos! This way, the surprise will be ours for sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? But isn't one quarter multiplied by four equal to one?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It is, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! What are we waiting for, then? Let's get going! That surprise is ours for the taking!

choices.text: Great. There's no one better at photography than I am.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: You look like you just can't wait to begin snapping some shots. Allow me to add that if your works are chosen, there'll be a special surprise just for you.

talks.objective: Complete the Chenyu Vale scenic photography contest

dialogues.speaker: Zhuchun
dialogues.text: Heyo, friendo! You've been all over, I imagine you've had the pleasure of admiring quite a few sights in your time?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuchun
dialogues.text: I wonder if the Chenyu Vale's spots for this contest will be able to top the ones you've experienced?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this pelican here yours, kid? Could we photograph it alongside Qiaoying Village?

dialogues.speaker: Mingjing
dialogues.text: Hree hree! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What are you saying?

dialogues.speaker: Mingjing
dialogues.text: It's pelican talk, which means "great, great!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You speak pelican?

dialogues.speaker: Mingjing
dialogues.text: Only a little... because I noticed when they eat, they don't stop going "hree hree! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!"

dialogues.speaker: Mingjing
dialogues.text: I'm sure they're happily saying that it's "great, great"!

dialogues.speaker: Mingjing
dialogues.text: So I learned to call to them in that manner too. They come over as soon as they hear, probably because they think there's food.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjing
dialogues.text: If you wanna photograph one, then maybe you could try calling out to one yourself! It's too bad I gotta get home now, otherwise, I could teach you some more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No worries, kiddo! We'll try it ourselves! Thanks, and get home safely!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's give it a go over there! If we can attract a pelican, it'll increase our work's chances of success!

talks.objective: Complete the Chenyu Vale scenic photography contest
Complete the Chenyu Vale scenic photography contest

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: Hang on! Don't come any closer! Are you... are you good people?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, we're the ones who saved you just now! Did you hit your head on something or...

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: Ah! You're right... I'm really sorry about that. My "Chenyu Vale Trek" has been nothing but dizzyingly bad luck... Thank... you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're participating in the photography contest, too?

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: You are as well? What a coincidence! I'm just an ordinary tourist, though... So I couldn't do anything about those hilichurls.

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: I came across those louts on the road, and they captured and brought me back here without letting me get a word in lengthwise. Hilichurls don't also collect tolls, do they? Preposterous... Luckily, I ran into you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... Today was a tough day for you indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: Not just today! Yesterday was terrible as well. I bought a rather expensive Kamera from a Fontaine merchant, but it broke after only a few uses. When I went back to find him, he was gone...

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: What a shady guy... Be sure to keep an eye on your wallet while you're out and about!

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry. Got a little sidetracked there. Since you're also taking part in the competition, you must be here to photograph Mt. Xuanlian, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: What say I share the best photography spot that I found around here with you as thanks? Here, I'll mark it on your map for you.

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: You can see it from here. In fact, it's right over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What about you then? Aren't you participating in the contest as well?

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: This area's rather dangerous, so it'd be best for me to switch things up. I remember the guide spoke of other locations... I think I should check out the Tea-Tasting Adeptus...

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: Yeah! That sounds good. Goodbye, you two! Hopefully, things start turning out well for me now!

talks.objective: Complete the Chenyu Vale scenic photography contest

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: My dear friend, are you here to participate in the photography competition as well?

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: As a Fontainian photographer, one who's emerged from the Kamera's birthplace, let me offer you some advice: the purest essence of photography lies within the Kamera itself.

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: Hence, I'd like to introduce you to someone. Back in my hometown, the Kameras he makes are beloved without exception. They come at reasonable prices, too, and I know just how to get my hands on one...

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: Hey... Don't give me that uninterested look! I'll get you an extra discount!

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: Hey... Don't leave!

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: Let's see... Where should I go next?

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Seeing how relaxed you look, I suppose you must be here to submit your photos. Just leave them with me.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Hmm, not bad at all. You must've put in a lot of work to capture such beautiful scenes. Well done.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Hmm... these photos...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Are ours not good enough?

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: It's quite the opposite... I've seen some excellent submissions these past few days, but your works are refreshing all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Let's take this shot of Qiaoying Village. The pelican adds a touch of liveliness to the tranquil village, contrasting stillness and movement... A one-of-a-kind approach, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: If it were just up to me, your works would certainly be selected for use.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! What a compliment! You're making Paimon blush a little.

choices.text: Blush? You're not the one who took these photos.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was just feeling flattered on your behalf! Paimon knows all about your modesty.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Well, in any case, our selection process will be completed before tomorrow morning.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: From eight in the morning until six at night, we will exhibit the selected works on the street outside Hezhe Post.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Thank you for participating in the "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" scenic photography contest. Don't forget to come back around tomorrow!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet! We're not gonna miss out on the final surprise!

choices.text: I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed now too.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: From eight in the morning until six at night, we will exhibit the selected works on the street outside Hezhe Post. Don't forget to come back around tomorrow!

talks.objective: Visit the exhibition of selected works outside Hezhe Post

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Ah, you've made it.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Have you seen the exhibited works? A total of eight works have been selected for this iteration of "Our Chenyu Vale Trek," and half of those are yours.

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! That's awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #See, {NICKNAME}? Paimon was right about getting four out of four! Paimon's math skills really are something!

choices.text: It's four out of eight, actually.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Heh, the judges also showed great appreciation for your other two works, much like I said yesterday.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: And so, please take this limited edition "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" commemorative photo album. It features all of the contest's selected works. You have earned it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This was the surprise? Ooh, it looks amazing!

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: If it's alright with you, I also have some Mora for you. Please take it. I'd like to thank you again for participating, this time on a personal level.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: This is my hometown, and you have forever captured the beauty of this place. These works will surely cause more people to fall in love with it.

response.speaker: Fangju
response.text: Thank you.

choices.text: Wow! Quite the mathematician, aren't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's try calling the pelicans.

choices.text: "Anng anng! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!"
"Hree hree! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!"

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: Uh-oh! That dupe from Inazuma is here as well. I'd better pretend I didn't notice him... Luckily, there's someone in between us, so he probably doesn't see me.

dialogues.speaker: Mali
dialogues.text: Darn it, why are these scenery photos so captivating? I don't wanna leave this place yet...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuchun
dialogues.text: These photos were shot quite nicely. It's just a shame that the atmosphere around me seems rather off...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuchun
dialogues.text: Maybe I should pick a different spot from which to appreciate them...

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: There he is! That shady Fontaine merchant! Has my luck really begun to turn around!?

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: I should just rush over and grab hold of him right now, but then I wouldn't be able to appreciate these charming photos of Chenyu Vale...

dialogues.speaker: Akai
dialogues.text: No... I would just suffer further loss that way. I'd be better off doing so after viewing them, especially for my selected work...

dialogues.speaker: Fangju
dialogues.text: I wish you all the best of luck.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew! Paimon took a look at the photos we've got: Qiaoying Village, the Lotus Pond, Jademouth, and Mt. Xuanlian! We've got 'em all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There won't be any other participants as hardworking as us, will there? If we don't win a prize after all this, it'll be a total travesty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the Lotus Pond by the Ancient Teatree King? Whaddaya know — just like the guidebook said, there are monsters!
